confirm_remove.description: Confirm permanent removal of the selected plant.

species_inaturalist.title: Species (iNaturalist)
species_inaturalist.description: Plants matching "{query}". The choice sets the species name and photo. {status}

species_trefle.title: Growth data (Trefle)
species_trefle.description: Trefle records for "{query}". Each entry says whether Trefle has growth data for it. Skip if none is the right plant or it adds nothing. {status}

species_perenual.title: Care data (Perenual)
species_perenual.description: Perenual records for "{query}". Perenual supplies watering and sunlight. Skip if none is the right plant. {status}

species.title: Re-match species data
species.description: Choose the plant, and optionally a name to search for instead of the plant name. Each provider is matched in turn and can be skipped.

relearn.name: Relearn baseline
relearn.description: Forget what the selected plants learned for their current placement (moisture range, watering cycles, light, temperature and humidity norms) and start calibrating again. Use it after repotting, moving the sensor, or when the learned range is wrong. The other placement's baseline is kept.

missing_moisture_sensor.title: Soil moisture sensor missing for {plant}
missing_moisture_sensor.description: {plant} uses {entity_id} as its soil moisture sensor, but that entity does not exist (it may have been renamed, removed or disabled). Until it is back, the plant waits for data. Choose the sensor again under Settings > Devices & services > Plant Helper > Configure > Edit a plant.

provider_key_rejected.title: {provider} rejected the API key
provider_key_rejected.description: {provider} refused the configured key, so its species data is not refreshed. Enter a valid key under Settings > Devices & services > Plant Helper > three-dot menu > Reconfigure. Data fetched earlier stays in use.

perenual_plan_mismatch.title: Perenual key is not on a paid plan
perenual_plan_mismatch.description: The Perenual plan is set to Paid, but Perenual refused a record because the key's plan does not cover it. Set the plan to Free under Reconfigure, so only records the key can open are offered, or upgrade the Perenual plan.

plants_not_rematched.title: Some plants use the old species matching
plants_not_rematched.description: These plants were added before species data was matched per provider: {plants}. They still match by name, which can pick the wrong plant. Re-match them under Settings > Devices & services > Plant Helper > Configure > Re-match species data.
